lines: Fuma-chan, you're going to the cafeteria, right?
Yeah, I'm hungry after all that fighting today. Shikanosuke, you're coming too, right?
I'm about to collapse I'm so hungry. I could eat a horse.
And just as I was about to leave the classroom with the hungry pair, numerous figures suddenly blocked our way.
A fire ninja of the Fuma Clan approached me with a harsh look in his eyes.
And he had brought some of his men with him. Not a one of them seemed to be friendly.
You're going to grant me moment of your time.
(So... these guys were Gaiza's subordinates, but they were ones who hadn't participated in the rebellion.)
Nevertheless, it didn't mean they were loyal to me, and that was clear from looking at their attitudes.
Heberybody was about to have lunch. What do you want from Fuma-chan, bringing all those guys with you?
Before I could say anything, Hebiko suddenly called out to them belligerently.
I have no business with the Octo-Bitch flunky. Stay back.
Huh? Are you here to pick a fight? You're gonna get inked up! Hebiko is hungry right now, so it's gonna be a lot!
Ggh, we just need to talk to him as the head of the Fuma Clan.
He's the head of the clan but he can't even talk to his own clan members!?
The troublesome nature of Hebiko's ink was well known within the Fuma Clan.
The men looked frightened, but repeated that they wanted to speak to the head of the clan.
You want to speak to the head of the clan? Well, I can tell by the look on your face that it's not going to be a pleasant conversation... But that's fine, I'll go with you. Just me.
The fire ninja jerked his head and I followed him.
You two go ahead to the cafeteria.
H-Hey, Fuma. No more fights or anything like that on the campus, okay?
Both of them seemed to be worried about me.
(Well, I have a feeling it's going to be more than just talking though.)
That's when I suddenly noticed another set of eyes on me.
How long had she been there? Yukikaze was looking at me.
Unlike Hebiko and Shikanosuke, she seemed to be amused that I was being taken away by the Fuma ninja.
Well, the whole story didn't concern her at all, so that was no surprise.
When her eyes met mine, she giggled as if to say, "My sympathies."
I gave her a look as if to say "Sheesh..." and shrugged my shoulders. Yukikaze giggled even more.
What are you doing? Come quickly.
I was taken to the poolside.
You use Fire Art, what are you planning to do in a place like this?
Don't tell me, you want the clan head to teach you how to swim? For the record, I'm not even a good swimmer.
They didn't twitch a muscle at my light-hearted jokes.
For fire ninja you guys are pretty cold. Anyways, what did you want from me?
As the head of the clan, don't you have anything to say to us?
As the head of the clan?
With the rebellion caused by Gaiza, the trust in the Fuma Clan has hit rock bottom.
What are you planning to do with the Fuma Clan from now on?
Whatever I might want to do, for now I have orders to capture Gaiza. That comes first.
My answer made the group of fire ninja grow even more angry.
That's an order from above, from the Taimanin village. I'm asking you, Fuma, as the head of the clan, if you have any ideas of what to do?!
Even if I told you, I don't think you'd listen to my orders. It's not like you've suddenly changed your opinion of me, right?
The Fire Ninja clicked his tongue in annoyance.
His subordinates were also complaining, "This guy is useless," or, "Is he really the head of the clan?"
I mean, look at you... hah, we would've been better off following Gaiza.
Do you have any idea how shameful it is to be a Fuma in this village?!
Sheesh... so that's why you came asking me to do something?
If you had joined the rebellion with such naive thinking, you would've gotten killed a long time ago.
You've been treating me like a fool, calling me "Diot," and now you're whining. No wonder Gaiza didn't ask you to take part in the rebellion.
What the hell are you talking about, Diot?!
You're a disgrace to the Fuma Clan!!
They were furious and came toward me.
I hadn't meant to go that far, but I had let out my true feelings.
It seemed like I would have to take one or two punches for this. I'd just let them give me a good beating and get it over with quickly.
And just as I was bracing myselfー
Who are you calling an embarrassment to the Fuma Clan?!
I looked up at the source of the sonorous voice and saw Hebiko looking down at us from the roof of the locker room.
All you do is whine and complain. You guys are pathetic.
And you're coming after Fuma-chan with that many people, even though he can't even fight properly on his own.
Hebiko had already turned into an octopus and was ready to fight.
Uwuwuh, Fuma's quarrels don't even have anything to do with me.
He was being held by Hebiko's tentacles and forcibly dragged along.
H-Hey guys, stop the fighting. If you have to fight, then do it when I'm not aroooound...
What are you talking about, Shikanosuke! Fuma-chan is in trouble! Let's go! Octopus Jump!!
Hebiko, and the wrapped up Shikanosuke, jumped down to the poolside.
Let's get them all at once!!
They came at us shouting cheesy lines like villains from some C-grade movie.
(So in the end it comes down to this... sheesh...)
